info.title: API.SH: On3
info.description: The On3 API from API.SH: public On3 data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The latest recruiting commitments, newest first, optionally for one class year or one team: each player's fields as in `/on3/v1/rankings`, plus `nil_value` and `recruitment_id`. Birth dates, ages, contact details and social accounts are not included. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-commits

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Team id (`23628`) or slug with id (`texas-longhorns-23628`) to list that team's commits.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-decommits

parameters.name: team

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One player's profile: `name`, `sport`, `position`, `class_year`, `height`, `weight`, `level`, `high_school`, `hometown`, `ranking` (current rating, stars and ranks), `rankings` (every ranking the player has had), `status` (committed, signed, enrolled or transfer, with the team and date) and `raw`. Birth dates, ages, contact details and social accounts are not included.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-player

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Player id (`7353`) or an On3 player link (`on3.com/rivals/arch-manning-7353/`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The teams in a player's recruitment: `team`, `status` (Offered, Visited, Committed, Enrolled...), `interest_level`, `official_visits`, `unofficial_visits`, `latest_visit`, `prediction`, `committed_date`, the recruiting `coaches` and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-player-interests

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Player id or an On3 player link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Recruiting rankings of high school (or junior college) prospects for a class year: the Industry consensus ranking or On3's own, by sport, position and state. Each player: `id`, `name`, `url`, `position`, `class_year`, `height`, `weight`, `high_school`, `hometown`, `state`, `ranking` (rating, stars, national/position/state rank, consensus rating, stars and ranks), `status` (committed, signed, enrolled), `status_date`, `committed_to`, `predictions` (teams with their prediction percent) and `raw`. Birth dates, ages, contact details and social accounts are not included. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-rankings

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Class year (1999-2035); the next class by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Players (high school, college and pro) matching a name: `id`, `name`, `url`, `position`, `class_year`, `ranking`, `current_team`, `sport`, `level` and `raw`. Birth dates, ages, contact details and social accounts are not included. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One team or school: `name`, `mascot`, `abbreviation`, `logo`, `city`, `type`, `division`, `primary_color`, `secondary_color`, its recruiting `class_ranking` for a sport and year (industry and On3 rank and score, commits, star counts) and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-team

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Team id (`23628`) or a slug with id (`texas-longhorns-23628`).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Class year for `class_ranking`; the next class by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-team-rankings

parameters.name: year

get.description:
Transfer portal entries for a season, newest first, filterable by status and position: each player's fields plus `status`, `entered_date`, `withdrawn_date`, `current_team`, `previous_teams`, `transfer_rating`, `predictions` and `nil_value`. Birth dates, ages, contact details and social accounts are not included. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-transfers

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Portal season; the current one by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The transfer portal's top-rated players for a season (best available and committed), with the same fields as `/on3/v1/transfers`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/on3-transfers-top

parameters.name: year

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
